brief:
Yasir Abbas, son of Palestinian Authority President Mahmoud Abbas and his special adviser, triggered widespread ridicule on social media after declaring that his family would be "the last to leave the camp, if we leave it alive," Shehab Wire reported. The statement prompted a wave of sarcasm and mockery from activists and citizens across platforms.

Abbas's comments appear to reference displacement from Palestinian refugee camps, a sensitive issue tied to broader Palestinian displacement and the right of return. The backlash reflects public skepticism about the commitment of senior Palestinian officials to core Palestinian causes.
